import ast,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")==""
root=Path("test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933").resolve()
v=root/"verification"
paths=[
v/"qwen3_14b_full_holdout_saved_score_20260929_1135/audit.py",
v/"frozen_fit_input_qwen3_14b_20260929_1135/readback.py",
v/"qwen3_14b_full_e2e_score_integrity_20260929_1135/audit.py",
v/"wait_qwen3_14b_audits_20260929_1135.py",
v/"test_wait_qwen3_14b_audits_20260929_1135.py",
v/"qwen25_14b_full_holdout_saved_score_20260929_0643/audit.py",
v/"frozen_fit_input_qwen25_14b_20260929_0643/readback.py",
v/"qwen25_14b_full_e2e_score_integrity_20260929_0643/audit.py",
v/"wait_qwen25_14b_1m_audits_schemafix_20260929_1030.py",
v/"qwen3_14b_completed_calibration_20260929_1124/results/manifest.json",
v/"qwen3_14b_completed_calibration_20260929_1124/execution.command.json",
root/"models/Qwen3-14B/calibration/training/Qwen3-14B_hgbmono_p50.pkl"]
hashes={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
for path in paths[:9]:
    if path.suffix==".py":compile(path.read_text(),str(path),"exec")
def functions(path):
    return {n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
old,new=functions(paths[8]),functions(paths[3])
unchanged=[name for name in ("latest_status","native_complete","ready","process_identity") if old[name]==new[name]]
assert len(unchanged)==4
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("qwen3_waiter_validation",paths[3])
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
assert module.MODEL=="Qwen3-14B"
assert module.successful_audit(v/module.CALIBRATION)
gates={stage:module.ready(root,stage) for stage,_,_ in module.STAGES}
assert gates=={"saved_score":False,"frozen_fit_input":False,"endpoints":False}
cal=json.loads(paths[9].read_text())
assert (cal["training_requests"],cal["timing_rows"],cal["training_cases"])==(800,9256,15)
assert hashes[str(paths[-1])]==cal["p50_bundle_sha256"]
for p,h in hashes.items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
print(json.dumps({"at":datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),"model":"Qwen3-14B","source_syntax_valid":True,"native_and_stage_gate_ast_unchanged":unchanged,"actual_current_readiness":gates,"calibration_audit_verified":True,"source_sha256_unchanged":hashes,"actual_audits_executed":False,"scope":"Prepared CPU audits and readiness only; actual independent-test/scoring/replay results are still required."}))
